patterns.note: The entry page features a strong, symmetrical, centered layout with primary brand elements (logo, name, motto, CTA) arranged vertically on a solid background.
A limited, high-contrast color palette of deep charcoal/brown and a rich gold is used consistently for brand elements, conveying a sense of luxury and heritage.
The typography combines a bold, classic serif for the main brand name, an elegant script for the motto, and a clean, understated sans-serif for the call to action, creating a sophisticated hierarchy.
No scroll-triggered motion or animations are observed on the provided entry page screenshots; the design relies on static visual hierarchy and brand presentation.

technique_notes: The entry page is designed as a full-screen, static brand introduction, presenting key identity elements (logos, name, motto, entry button) centrally on a solid background. No scroll-triggered motion or interactive elements are present on this initial view.

The site uses a combination of custom fonts, including a classic serif for primary branding, an elegant script for secondary text, and a simple sans-serif for functional elements, to establish a distinct brand voice.

design_tokens.type_scale: A very large, bold serif heading (~4x body) is paired with a medium-sized, elegant script motto and a smaller, uppercase sans-serif for interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — the entry page features significant negative space around centered brand elements, creating a sense of grandeur and focus.

standout: The site's entry page is a distinctive, full-screen brand statement, eschewing typical navigation or content for a focused presentation of its identity through crests, a prominent name, and a motto. It creates an immediate sense of exclusivity and heritage before any functional interaction.
